chapter: Teaching, the 1951 Big Show and New York nights
title: The 1952 Stan Kenton band
summary: The following year he toured with Kenton's band, with Maynard Ferguson and Frank Rosolino.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: No, he (unintelligible). But it was the musical history. Duke Ellington and Nat Cole. So see, these things you can't relive. You know, I think about them and am grateful that I lived in this era that I could be a part of this, you know. The next year, '52, I think it was Stan Kenton, who also had a great band at this time. This was one of his great bands. Let's see, I think it was Bob Burgess, Buddy Childers, Don Bagby --
Maynard Ferguson. A vocalist they had, a vocalist by the name of Kay Brown.
